title: Direction Phrases: Upside Down, Inside Out

vocabulary.meaning_en: with the inside part on the outside (clothes)
vocabulary.example: Your shirt is inside out; I can see the label.
She knows this company inside out.

vocabulary.word: round and round / around and around
vocabulary.meaning_en: moving in circles; talking about the same thing again and again
vocabulary.example: We're going round and round the same problem.
The tip of the pen is broken.

vocabulary.note_ar: أكثر استخدامًا في بريطانيا: in tip-top shape
vocabulary.example: The room is in tip-top shape.

vocabulary.meaning_en: with the top at the bottom; also in the wrong order, in a mess
vocabulary.example: You're holding the book upside down.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to turn something to the opposite position
vocabulary.example: Invert the glass to dry it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in the correct position, not upside down
vocabulary.example: Turn the box right side up.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to keep changing your mind about a decision
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يتقلّب في رأيه / يغيّر قراره باستمرار
vocabulary.example: Make a decision and don't flip-flop.
The new film was a flop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: confused, mixed up, in a mess
vocabulary.note_ar: لا نقول عن كتاب مقلوب topsy-turvy بل upside down
vocabulary.note_en: For a book in the wrong position, say upside down, not topsy-turvy.
vocabulary.example: After the move, our house was topsy-turvy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move left and right suddenly, not in a straight line
vocabulary.note_ar: نقول zigged and zagged وليس العكس
vocabulary.note_en: We say "zigged and zagged", not the other way.
vocabulary.example: We zigzagged through the city streets.

fine_lines.title: upside down vs topsy-turvy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: upside down: مقلوب فعلًا (الأعلى في الأسفل)، ويستخدم أيضًا للفوضى. topsy-turvy: فوضى واضطراب فقط، ولا نقوله عن كتاب أو قلم مقلوب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Upside down: really inverted (top at the bottom); also for a mess. Topsy-turvy: only for a confused mess, not for a book or pen in the wrong position.

examples.sentence: The picture is hanging upside down.
Everything is topsy-turvy since the new boss came.

fine_lines.title: inside out (clothes) vs know inside out
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مع الملابس: مقلوبة. مع know: يعرف كل شيء عن الموضوع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: With clothes: the inside is outside. With know: to know everything about it.

examples.sentence: He knows the city inside out.

expressions.meaning_en: The inside of your shirt is on the outside.
expressions.example: Excuse me, your shirt is inside out.

expressions.phrase: I know this book inside out.
expressions.example: Ask me anything; I know this book inside out.

expressions.meaning_en: We keep talking about the same thing.
expressions.example: Let's stop; we're going round and round.
I feel in tip-top shape after my holiday.
Since the flood, my life is upside down.
The government flip-flopped on the new tax.

questions.question: "We made sudden turns left and right through the streets." Shorter:
"They argued about the same things again and again." They went ___.
"Her shirt had the inside on the outside." Her shirt was ___.
"I know this company ___." (everything about it)
questions.explanation_ar: know inside out = يعرف كل التفاصيل.

questions.question: Which is correct for a book in the wrong position?
questions.explanation_en: A book in the wrong position is upside down.

questions.question: "Invert" means:
choices: to turn to the opposite position

questions.question: "Since we moved, everything is ___." (a confused mess)
